newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan worried by U.S. missiles strikes on Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Jordan worried by U.S. missiles strikes on Iraq.

text.p: Jordan on Tuesday expressed concern over U.S. missile strikes on Iraqi targets and called for restraint to avoid a further escalation of violence.

"Jordan is following with concern the latest escalation in the situation and the military operations which might return Iraq to the cycle of violence and counter-violence," Information Minister Marwan Muasher told reporters.
"Jordan rejects any attempt to harm Iraq's sovereignty and the unity of its people and territory," Muasher added.

"We warn against continued escalation and urge self-restraint, avoiding violence, and adherence to principles of international legitimacy and the return to dialogue based on these resolutions and respect of human rights of all Iraqis," he said.
Muasher said Jordan, which has been calling for changes in Baghdad since senior Iraqi defections last year, had not been used as a base for Tuesday's strikes.
"Jordanian territory was not and will not be used for any aggression on any Arab brotherly state," he said.
